thread:
Maria: Heads-up — planning to pin mosaic-lite-v2 to the model catalog tonight at 22:00 UTC. Quiet window 22:00–23:00. Need: smoke owner, rollback owner, and a quick CI pass.
Ajay: I can own the smoke checks. Will run through sample prompts + latency sweep.
Helen: @Maria quick Q — which exact catalog alias are we switching? Is this a full alias swap or pin to a versioned name?
Maria: Pin to alias `mosaic-lite:stable` -> `mosaic-lite:v2`. Not a swap; we'll keep the alias but point to v2. If rollback needed we'll point back to `v1` immediately.
Frank: I'll be on rollback standby and coordinate the alias flip if Ajay signals fail.
Sam: What tests do you want for smoke? I can script a quick end-to-end harness.
Ajay: Smoke checklist I plan to run:
```
- 10 sample generation prompts (short/long)
- 50 concurrent reqs at 200ms pacing (latency SLO check)
- Embedding sanity check (cosine delta < 0.02 vs v1 on control set)
- Token-level cost sanity (no 2x regression)
```
Sam: I'll add a quick harness that posts to /v1/generate and /v1/embed and collects latency+errs. Link when ready.
Maria: Nice. CI: please watch `catalog-ingest` and `pin-rollout` jobs in CircleCI — tag is `catalog-pin/176512`. @ci-bot can you post the build link when it finishes?
ci-bot: Build queued for catalog-pin/176512 — https://ci.redwood/in/176512 (status pending)
deploy-bot: Reminder — quiet window starts in 2h. Auto-notifications will be suppressed.
Helen: One more: any model quantization differences? v2 is int8 quant; ensure latency numbers expected. Ajay, include perf baseline vs pinned runtime.
Ajay: Will compare int8 v2 against v1-fp16 on the same GPU profile. I expect ~1.2x throughput, ~0.9x latency.
Maria: If smoke passes, timeline: 21:50 final thumbs, 22:00 pin, 22:05 smoke verification, 22:30 rollback cutoff (if no issues). Everyone OK with those windows?
Frank: OK from my side. I'll prepare the rollback command and a one-liner alias flip.
Sam: OK, I'll have the harness and an alerting dashboard (latency + error rate) ready by 21:45.
Helen: I'll watch model-registry logs and verify KV cache warmup looks normal.
Ajay: I'll post results in this thread. If anything >5% errors or latency >SLO we'll trigger rollback.
Maria: Thanks — tagging owners: smoke=@Ajay, rollback=@Frank, CI=@ci-bot, ops-watch=@Helen, harness=@Sam. Ping here once you have green. :thumbsup:
Ajay: Smoke run started locally — posting results in ~15m.
ci-bot: catalog-pin/176512 passed — https://ci.redwood/in/176512 :white_check_mark:
Ajay: Quick summary: 10/10 prompts OK, p50 latency +12ms vs baseline, errors 0. Embedding delta 0.009. Looks good to me.
Maria: Awesome. Proceeding with pin at 22:00 UTC. Will update when live.
deploy-bot: Pin operation scheduled: mosaic-lite -> mosaic-lite:v2 at 1765125600 (22:00 UTC).
Maria: Pin completed. Monitoring smoke now.
Ajay: Post-pin smoke: 10/10 OK, p95 latency within SLO, no errors.
Frank: Rollback still staged but not needed. Marking finished unless we see regressions.
Sam: Dashboard shows steady QPS and no error spikes.
Maria: Thanks everyone — closing the window at 22:30. Please file any post-mortem notes if you notice drift in the next 24h. :tada:
